app.name: Rocky
locked.title: Open Rocky from its launcher
locked.body: For safety, Rocky only accepts browser tabs opened by its launcher. Run the launcher (or npm start) again and it will open the right address.
onboarding.title: Pick a model and you're ready.
onboarding.intro: Rocky runs only on your computer. Conversations and settings stay here; no usage data is sent anywhere.
onboarding.networkValue: Only the model endpoint you choose
model.model.placeholder: Pick from the list or type a model name
model.notConfigured: No model yet. Pick one in Settings to start.
threads.empty: Your first conversation will appear here.
threads.delete.confirm: Delete this conversation? This cannot be undone.
chat.placeholder: Tell Roko what to do… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
chat.empty: What would you like to do? Just say it.
chat.error.model-not-configured: No model yet. Choose one in Settings first.
chat.connectError: The conversation did not load. Reload the page.
panel.failed: The last turn had a problem
settings.title: Settings
error.network: Cannot reach Rocky. Make sure it is still running.
mode.label: Approval mode
mode.ask-always.hint: Ask before every edit and command; reads don't ask
mode.ask-when-needed.hint: Ask only for dangerous commands, secrets and outside actions
mode.hands-off.hint: For now the same as Ask when needed: dangerous commands, secrets and outside actions ask
project.label: Project folder
project.hint: Rocky reads, edits and runs commands only inside this folder. Paste its full path, for example D:\Code\my-app.
project.error.invalid-project: Enter a full path (for example D:\Code\my-app).
onboarding.step2: Choose a project folder (you can do this later)
settings.mode.hint: New conversations start in this mode; each conversation can switch next to the input box.
approval.reason.deny-rule: it matches one of your deny rules
approval.reason.allow-rule: it matches one of your allow rules
approval.reason.safe-list: it is on the built-in safe list
approval.reason.unparseable: Rocky can't tell what this command will do
approval.allowSession: Allow for this conversation (identical content only)
approval.reasonPlaceholder: Tell Rocky why, or what to do instead (Enter to send)
approval.keys: 1–4 to choose, Enter to confirm, Esc to reject, Ctrl+E for full screen
approval.notify: Rocky is waiting for your approval
diff.tooLarge: Too large or not a text file; no preview.
changes.confirmTitle: Restore these files to how they were before this turn?
changes.modifiedSince: This file changed again later; restoring overwrites those changes.
changes.error.content-changed: The files changed after you confirmed. Review them again before restoring.
receipt.retry: It didn't work, do it again
receipt.retryPrompt: I checked and this action did not work: {action}. Please do it again.
jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.empty: No jobs yet. Ask Rocky to “hand it to OpenCode” in a conversation and it shows up here.
jobs.select: Choose a job to see its details.
jobs.unavailable: OpenCode was not found on this computer. Install it (npm i -g opencode-ai) to hand coding work to it.
jobs.network: Each time it starts, OpenCode contacts registry.npmjs.org to check plugins; without rg on PATH it downloads ripgrep from GitHub.
jobs.matches: Every change matches the approved content.
jobs.checkNone: No test command to run (package.json has no test script).
jobs.warning.uncommitted-changes: The project had uncommitted changes; the job started from the last commit and does not include them.
jobs.applyTitle: Apply these changes to the project?
jobs.discardConfirm: Discard this job's worktree? Its changes are deleted with it.
jobs.problemsApply: Verification found problems; review the diff before applying.
jobs.error.project-changed: The project folder changed; this job does not belong to the current project.
jobs.error.content-changed: The files changed after you confirmed. Review them again.
jobs.error.not-applicable: This job can't be applied now.
approval.title.delegate: {actor}wants to hand a job to OpenCode: {title}
approval.delegateNote: OpenCode works in a separate worktree; you still approve its actions, Rocky verifies the result, and nothing touches the project until you apply it.
memory.hint: What Rocky remembers is saved as Markdown files in this folder. Ask Rocky to “remember…” to add one; every write is receipted and can be restored from the change card in the conversation.
skills.hint: A skill is a folder with a SKILL.md (name and description at the top). Put the folder in the location below to install it; Rocky reads the full text only when needed. Skills grant no extra permissions.
mcp.hint: MCP servers add tools. Every call goes through Rocky's approval; mark tools that never change anything as read-only, or turn off tools you don't want.
mcp.name: Name (letters, digits, - and _)
mcp.env: Environment (one KEY=value per line, kept on this computer)
mcp.headers: HTTP headers (one Name=value per line, kept on this computer)
approval.title.agentOther: {actor}wants to do something that needs your approval: {title}
rules.hint: Commands that match a rule are allowed or refused without asking. Rules match the start of the command; a final * means any remaining arguments, for example npm test *. Allow rules never cover dangerous commands or outside actions: those always ask.
suggest.text: You have approved commands like this {count} times. Let them run without asking from now on?
suggest.hint: This adds a permanent allow rule you can remove in Settings at any time; dangerous commands and outside actions still ask.
plan.title: Rocky offers {count} options: {title}
plan.commands: Choosing this pre-approves these commands (exact matches only):
plan.note: Once chosen, the listed commands don't ask again in this conversation; other actions, dangerous commands and outside actions still ask.
plan.keys: Number keys choose an option, {revise} asks for changes, Esc rejects
approval.reason.plan: this is a plan for you to choose
